title: A gym that cannot take new enquiries still shows 'Ask a question' and the AI helper on its web page
what: When a gym's plan does not allow adding members (or the account is read-only), its web page still opens and its main button becomes 'Ask a question: the gym replies to you on WhatsApp or by phone'. The visitor writes their name, number and question, presses send, and only then is told 'This gym is not taking questions here right now. Please visit the gym.' The AI helper box is shown too and refuses the same way. The page hides only 'Become a member' for this case.
expected: The web page reads the same 'can this gym take an enquiry' state the forms use: while it is off, the page hides the question form and the AI helper (or says up front to call or visit), instead of inviting a question it will refuse.
who: visitors of a gym on a plan without adding members
how_often: every visit to such a gym page, once gym web pages are switched on
fix_line: Hide the question form and AI helper when the gym cannot take enquiries, the same way 'Become a member' is hidden

items.reason: Listed: switches LANDING, GYM_PAGES, PAGE_AI, JOIN_PAY; owner settings published, indexable, show_phone, whatsapp, ai_helper; HQ hidden_by_hq and gym_page_off; gym status suspended; plan gate addMember (join closed); automations: page data cache 5 min, 90-day chat sweep, offline copy skip list.

Should-read map: GYM_PAGES -> host, forms, chat, admin rows, help, assistant; PAGE_AI -> chat box, chat calls, admin switch; LANDING -> both sites and the demo form; JOIN_PAY -> Become a member words; published/hidden/off/suspended -> page, photos, ask, report, chat; show_phone/whatsapp -> buttons and AI chat; indexable -> robots tag and meta; join closed -> Become a member, ask form, AI helper; reports -> HQ; site pages -> offline copy.

Reads present for every switch; misses: photo check ignores gym_page_off (FN-B-switch-hq-app-02), reports read by nobody (FN-L14-server-database-3-01), ask form and AI helper ignore join closed (01), offline copy skip list misses the member site and get-app pages (FN-L16-web-pages-03). Ask after gym_page_off is a written choice (0090:24-25).

evidence: data:Crispy Curves (gym_id filter): gym_pages rows 0, published 0, timings set 1, gym details record 1 with phone 0 and address 0
items.reason: The member fields in field-fill.csv are not read by this area. The gym page needs the gym phone, address, timings and a page row: Crispy Curves has timings only, no page yet.
The web page editor asks for the missing phone and address right where they are used ('Add your gym's phone number in Settings -> Gym details first', 'Address: Not added yet').
Missing phone or address only hides those buttons; the editor prompts for them; no feature breaks silently. No finding.

Ran the shared rule and all 4 page copies on 12 real autofill and paste shapes (+91 with spaces or dashes, 0 prefix, 0091, brackets and dots, Hindi digits, non-breaking space, hidden direction marks, +44): every Indian number came out as the same 10 digits; the foreign number is refused by the 10-digit check. No phone box has a length limit; names 80, city 40, join date is a date box.
Rule applied: no box cuts or refuses a real autofill. No finding.
